name: chunk_local_cumsum_vector
description: Per-chunk vector-gate cumulative sum with signature chunk_local_cumsum_vector(g, chunk_size, reverse=False, scale=None). g has shape [B,T,H,S] and T is partitioned into contiguous chunks of chunk_size. For every (b, head, vector column), compute the cumulative sum along the time axis within each chunk; reverse=True accumulates from the chunk end back toward its start, and scale multiplies the result when provided. Return a newly allocated float32 tensor with the same [B,T,H,S] shape; inputs are not modified. T is expected to be divisible by chunk_size. The native fast path covers forward, no-scale cases with power-of-two S <=128, and a general masked path covers other S and mode combinations. The suite exercises bfloat16 g with chunk sizes 16/32/64 and S from 16 to 128.
